review_text: This is one of my favorite cafés! I’ve been here around six times already, and I even have a loyalty card. The place has a cozy and peaceful atmosphere, making it perfect for studying or getting work done. It’s also conveniently located near my house, which is a big plus. The staff are always friendly, welcoming, and approachable, making every visit a pleasant experience. My go-to order is their matcha drinks, and they never disappoint. Overall, it’s a café I keep coming back to and would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable place to study, work, or simply relax.

We went to addu bangkal, while my daughter is taking the qeac entrance exam I was looking for a place to stay and luckily it is just located near addu bangkal. The coffee scent welcomes you the moment you open the door. I loved it! We visited late October so as you can see there’s halloween decorations. Surprisingly they accept card payment, I was impressed because not all coffee shops accept card payment and this was a plus! I ordered the cheesecake latte and it was so good.
Visited on a Sunday around 10am. The place was cozy. There are only 2 groups of customers including us so there's much space. Food wise, it was an average serving, average taste.
The food serving is so worth it and recommendable!!! I just found this cafe in google recommendations and it went as expected. Great service too by the way!! They’ve rocked this industry so far
Great food and coffee options. They are open til midnight. Ambiance feels relaxing too.

Coffee lovers, rejoice! Just had the best experience at Kofi Gram and I can’t stop raving about it! The cozy ambiance, paired with their coffee brews, makes it the perfect spot to chill or catch up with friends. Their Iced Mocha was a total standout – smooth, flavorful, and just the right kick! If you're in Davao, don’t miss out on this gem! 🖤

Our recent saturday night out was a bomb! We arrived around 9 pm and the place was so quiet matched with very welcoming smiles of the staff. The place was trendy and at the same time offers a romantic vibe making it perfect for what we want for a date night. Our orders were serve in less than 10 minutes. Everything was delicious! We tried the beef quesadilla, non coffee chocolate lava drink and blueberry smoothie. And oh! Aside from the warming aesthetical design, a relaxing background music was also played. A+!

Koffee Gram was such a wonderful addition to our wedding reception. Our guests really enjoyed the coffee station, especially during the later part of the celebration when everyone was relaxing and chatting. The quality of coffee was great and your staff was very friendly and accommodating throughout the event. Thank you!

my order is hot spanish latte. the milk was under aeration due to its watery texture. its not over steamed since its not that hot. also, i didnt taste the coffee/espresso even though its 60/40 (if i am not mistaken, but i am sure its not 100% arabica since i asked the barista). i love the atmosphere and the service they provide.

although pricey, still one of the best cafés out there. Alert and active at 8 a.m. This cute and clean cafe fronts Ateneo Senior HS in Bangkal. Evident along the highway. Only one parking slot at the front. Counter staff was accommodating. Orders took a while though. Prices are reasonable and measures up to taste and size. The oozing with cheese quesedilla was soft and came with two dips too. The honey lemon yakult was new for me and lightly tangy. Pasta con Pollo Asado was savory. Will return…

Ambiance is a 10/10 for me, although Food is quite expensive, Coffee is good: We ordered DarkMocha and Matcha Frappe 10/10. Took 15-20mins for our order to be served.
